data.title: blog/: build the /blog site from BRANDING.md — home, post pages, posting workflow

data.to:
Build the /blog sub-site from blog/BRANDING.md (written in FA-31).

WHY: The user wants a place to publish their writing at forrestalmasi.com/blog, styled per the Web 2.0 brief.

DELIVERABLE:
- blog/index.html — blog home: masthead, post list with excerpts and permalinks, sidebar, footer.
- blog/style.css — separate stylesheet, per the CLAUDE.md sub-site authoring contract.
- Individual post pages plus a documented way to add a new post without a build step.

CONSTRAINTS:
- Follow the sub-site authoring contract in CLAUDE.md (ids prefixed with the site name, relative url() for local assets, no external requests unless the brief names a font, no horizontal scroll, full-bleed background) so the folder could be mapped into a viewport bucket later if wanted.
- NOT mapped in sites.config.json and the root index.html is NOT rebuilt for this task — /blog is a standalone destination. Do not hand-edit root index.html.
- Everything the brief specifies must actually appear in the page.

CONTENT: Do not fabricate opinions or biography in the user's voice. Ship a genuine first "Hello world"-style post about starting the blog plus a copy-to-write post template; the user supplies the real writing.

data.body: Plan written (574 lines). Files: blog/{index,archive}.html, blog/style.css, blog/posts/2026-09-03-hello-world.html, blog/posts/_template.html, blog/feed.xml, blog/README.md. No blog/script.js and no Search module — a client-side filter over a one-post list is a dead widget by the brief's rule 2, so the site ships zero JS. Key decisions: (1) NOT noindex — sibling folders carry noindex because build.js inlines their bodies into the root page, making the standalone copy a duplicate; /blog is not in sites.config.json, its content is unique, and it exists to be read, so index.html/archive.html/posts get canonical + no robots meta, while _template.html keeps noindex. (2) Exactly one real post, no placeholder entries — inventing entries is the dead-widget failure the brief forbids and the task forbids fabricating in the author's voice; the post is written long enough that the front-page excerpt + 'Continue reading' is a genuine excerpt, so the whole entry anatomy is exercised by one post. (3) url() tension resolved: verified the brief holds to zero url() everywhere it could have cheated (ground is gradients, chiclet is drawn, avatar is markup), so ONE stylesheet serves ./style.css and ../style.css; I made the avatar inline SVG rather than to kill the per-depth src, and both inline SVGs carry no internal ids so they can repeat in one document. (4) Sidebar modules made load-bearing concretely with a one-post corpus, incl. an absolute-threshold tag-cloud step table (1 post -> step 1) rather than a relative max. (5) Badge recipe goes on the truthful footer badge row, never a NEW/BETA sticker, which ages into a lie without a build step. (6) Yellow Fade made live by pointing every permalink at posts/.html#blog-entry-. Restated the FA-31 review finding at the top: style.css must never contain the string #site-blog.
